description.en:
Evolves the Fighting Spirit of one of the player's recruited players into another Fighting Spirit, keeping its level.

The player is found by its parameter ID among the recruits, and the new Fighting Spirit is named by its ID; both are hashed with CRC32.
Unlike CMND_ATTACH_AVATAR, nothing is detached or returned to the inventory: the Fighting Spirit ID is simply replaced. The level stays what it was, or becomes 1 if the player had no Fighting Spirit yet.

The ev_main helpers RunEvolutionAvatar, RunEvolutionAvatarUseMsg and RunEvolutionAvatarOnlyMsg wrap this call with the jingle and the message.
Player parameter ID of the recruited player, e.g. "para_cp0008".
ID of the Fighting Spirit it evolves into, e.g. "ck0033".

true once the Fighting Spirit has been replaced.
null if the engine is not ready, fewer than 2 arguments were given, or the player is not among the recruits.

examples.case: The evolve step of ev_main's RunEvolutionAvatarEx (real usage)

examples.code:
// Story event where the protagonist's Fighting Spirit evolves
RunEvolutionAvatar("para_cp0008", "ck0033");
